thresholds.MILESTONE_exposure: ≥20% improvement in tissue AUC vs CereVasc existing
thresholds.MILESTONE_dose: ≥30% reduction in required dose for same exposure

note: These are PROVISIONAL engineering targets, not facts. The coder must justify or revise them based on clinical literature.
justification: 20% improvement is the minimum that would be clinically detectable in a small trial. 2× residence time would halve dosing frequency — operationally meaningful for chronic conditions.
